watches.name: ORIGIN 40 DLC Purple Fumé
watches.description: The all-new Origin 40 has every characteristic that made the original such a classic, but with a series of refinements for 2026. The slight reduction in case size gives the Origin 40 the classic 40:20 proportions; 40mm case and 20mm lug width. The shift to a Miyota 9015 not only introduces a smooth high-beat sweep, but also allows the Origin to be a mere 12mm thick on wrist. BGW9 lume blocks adorn the dial for incredible legibility both during the day and after dark. There is even a full lume dial option for those who simply cannot get enough lume! There are two bracelets to choose from, an H-link and a J-style, both all-brushed, both quick release, and both featuring an on-the-fly adjustable clasp. The precision-engineered 120-click bezel delivers a crisp and confident action, while the 200m water resistance ensures the Origin 40 is ready for daily wear, travel, swimming, and adventure. The large 6.5mm screw-down crown offers excellent grip and ease of operation, even in wet conditions. From the compact proportions and fully brushed finishing, to the highperformance specifications and signature lume design, the Origin 40 has been built to deliver the feel of a serious modern tool watch while remaining unmistakably an Erebus.

watches.name: Nexus Purple Mosaic Mother of Pearl
watches.description: The Erebus Nexus Premium represents our most refined and luxurious watch design to date. Designed entirely from the ground up by Erebus, it brings together the proportions and presence of a modern integrated sports watch with elevated finishing, distinctive dial craftsmanship and Swiss mechanical performance. Designed around a compact and highly wearable 38.5mm case , the Nexus delivers the presence of a luxury sports watch while maintaining a slim 12mm profile and exceptional comfort on the wrist. At its heart is the Swiss-Made Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement , chosen for its proven reliability, smooth performance and premium mechanical pedigree. The defining feature of Nexus Premium is its hand-laid Mosaic Mother of Pearl dial . Each dial is individually assembled from carefully positioned sections of natural Mother of Pearl to elevate this watch to a level not seen before in an Erebus creation. The geometric mosaic transforms as it catches the light creating incredible dial play. As a result, every dial has its own elevated distinct character. Every element of the Nexus has been designed to work in harmony. The sculpted curves of the case are echoed through the hands and indices, while the custom-designed integrated bracelet features flowing curved mid links, vertically brushed surfaces and polished edge detailing. A double-domed sapphire crystal with clear anti-reflective coating provides exceptional clarity, while BGW9 Super-LumiNova ensures strong low-light visibility. From its intricate Mosaic dial to its sculpted case and integrated bracelet, the Nexus Premium brings together distinctive craftsmanship, refined proportions and Swiss mechanical performance in a watch that is unmistakably Erebus.

watches.description: The all-new Origin 40 has every characteristic that made the original such a classic, but with a series of refinements for 2026. From the compact proportions and fully brushed finishing, to the highperformance specifications and signature lume design, the Origin 40 has been built to deliver the feel of a serious modern tool watch while remaining unmistakably an Erebus.

watches.name: ORIGIN GMT Classic Deep Teal
watches.description: The Erebus Origin GMT is an evolution of the highly successful Erebus Origin 41. The two watches may share DNA but the Origin GMT brings a raft of material improvements, and the extra capability provided by a GMT complication. New bracelet and bezel options make the Origin GMT look and feel like a more upscale offering, yet Erebus' relentless focus on value ensures the price remains as affordable as ever. And with the cornerstones of all 316L stainless steel construction, 200m of water resistance, sapphire crystal, and incredible legibility, the Origin GMT remains a tool watch to its core. T he Classic range boasts four model choices, all with applied two-piece logos, framed date windows and comfort enhancements to the custom spec Curved H-Link bracelet. The standout feature of the range though, are the custom made, fully lumed, sandblasted bicolour ceramic bezel inserts. These are something normally found on watches costing thousands of dollars, and not hundreds of dollars. Whether you pick from the Classic or Premium ranges, the Erebus Origin GMT is the ultimate tool watch for travel and adventure.

watches.name: Twenty-Four 40 Contour
watches.description: The Erebus Twenty-Four introduces something rarely seen in modern watchmaking; a true 24-hour time display housed within a clean, highly legible field watch design. At midday, the dial transitions from 1–12 to 13–24, before reverting again at midnight. The result is a genuine military time experience that adds mechanical intrigue to everyday timekeeping. Designed to be worn anywhere and everywhere, the Twenty-Four balances technical fascination with practicality. Offered in both 38mm and 40mm case sizes, it delivers strong wrist presence while maintaining a slim, comfortable profile. Powered by a custom modified Miyota 9000 series movement, the Twenty-Four combines Japanese high-beat reliability with long-term durability and accuracy. As with every Erebus release, the specifications are uncompromising. A flat sapphire crystal with multi-layer anti-reflective coating ensures exceptional clarity, while BGW9 Super-LumiNova on the hands and markers guarantees legibility after dark. Each watch is supplied on a colour-matched leather strap and includes an additional high-quality military style strap as standard, giving you versatility straight out of the box. The Twenty-Four represents our commitment to doing something different, without compromising on quality, finishing, or value.

watches.name: TITAN Tiger's Eye
watches.description: The Erebus Titan is the undisputed king of the Erebus diver range. The largest and most impressive Erebus diver to date, the Titan carries the highest specs of any of our family of watches. Built for collectors who don’t shy away from bold statements, the Titan is impressively large and imposing at 44mm but also surprisingly wearable, with a compact lug to lug of well under 50mm. Designed to withstand the depths with 500m water resistance, the Titan comes with Viton® gaskets and a helium escape valve to complete its genuine deep diving credentials. The Erebus team is pushing boundaries with a host of firsts: a full lumed dial version, lumed crowns at 4 o’clock for comfort and easy access, a pair of stealthy DLC options, and hardness coating on all cases and bracelets for enhanced durability. Despite its hardcore specs, the Titan doesn’t skimp on refinement. With a two-piece applied logo and lumed applied indices, this incredibly capable watch looks strikingly handsome on wrist. Dial choices are off the charts. Choose between rare volcanic obsidian or meteorite mineral dials, fumé sunburst or granular dials, all choices complemented by all brushed, fully lumed ceramic bezel inserts. The Titan backs up its incredible value for money, with incredible performance, fantastic legibility, and the long-term reliability of TMI’s stalwart NH35 movement. Finally, a custom designed super engineer bracelet featuring quick release and lots of micro adjustment, rounds out what is the most complete diver watch package Erebus has ever produced. Erebus has produced the microbrand world’s ultimate value diver. The only question is, are you ready for the Titan?

watches.name: ASCENT 39 Blue Enamel
watches.description: Erebus’s first Go Anywhere, Do Anything (GADA) sports watch is more than just a pretty face. Designed to be worn on any occasion, whether at the office, on a night out, a hike, or even a swim, the Ascent always looks like it is worth thousands more than its asking price. The attention to detail the Erebus team have lavished on the Ascent is the reason for its name; it represents an elevation in all elements of its design, its specifications, and its construction. Our vision was simple; analyse the world’s best sports watches, then mix in our own Erebus DNA to create the best value GADA watch possible. Running a Japanese-made Miyota 9015 movement means that the Ascent sports a wrist hugging slimline case profile and enjoys a satisfyingly smooth sweep of its needle-sharp second hand. The case finishing on the Ascent is superb, with the perfect combination of brushing and polishing to give the watch the wrist presence you always want. The multifaceted applied indices and stunning bespoke handset preside over a wide selection of incredible dials, meaning you’re sure to find an Ascent that suits your personal taste and style. Choose between rich and lustrous Enamel, colourful Fumé Sunburst, or mesmerising Erebus branded Helix dials. Or go even more exotic with our mineral dial selection in Aventurine, Malachite and Tigers Eye. Every choice is simply outstanding. Select between either ‘O’ and ‘J’ style bracelets, then add our additional branded leather, rubber, and military-style straps to give your Ascent a different look and feel in seconds. All changes are achieved seamlessly and without tools using our quick release system on all straps and bracelets. The Ascent takes our brand, and your wrist, to the next level.

watches.name: TITAN Red
watches.description: The Erebus Titan is the undisputed king of the Erebus diver range. The largest and most impressive Erebus diver to date, the Titan carries the highest specs of any of our family of watches. Built for collectors who don’t shy away from bold statements, the Titan is impressively large and imposing at 44mm but also surprisingly wearable, with a compact lug to lug of well under 50mm. Designed to withstand the depths with 500m water resistance, the Titan comes with Viton® gaskets and a helium escape valve to complete its genuine deep diving credentials. The Erebus team is pushing boundaries with a host of firsts: a full lumed dial version, lumed crowns at 4 o’clock for comfort and easy access, a pair of stealthy DLC options, and hardness coating on all cases and bracelets for enhanced durability. Despite its hardcore specs, the Titan doesn’t skimp on refinement. With a two-piece applied logo and lumed applied indices, this incredibly capable watch looks strikingly handsome on wrist. Dial choices are off the charts. Choose between rare volcanic obsidian or meteorite mineral dials, fumé sunburst or granular dials, all choices complemented by all brushed, fully lumed ceramic bezel inserts. The Titan backs up its incredible value for money, with incredible performance, fantastic legibility, and the long-term reliability of TMI’s stalwart NH35 movement. Finally, a custom designed super engineer bracelet featuring quick release and lots of micro adjustment, rounds out what is the most complete diver watch package Erebus has ever produced. Erebus has produced the microbrand world’s ultimate value diver. The only question is, are you ready for the Titan?

watches.name: ORIGIN GMT Premium Blue
watches.description: The Erebus Origin GMT is an evolution of the highly successful Erebus Origin 41. The two watches may share DNA but the Origin GMT brings a raft of material improvements, and the extra capability provided by a GMT complication. The choice of TMI's NH34 automatic calibre ensures the watch will perform reliably for years, if not decades, and the Origin GMT still sports dimensions that will wear beautifully on a wide range of wrist sizes. New bracelet and bezel options make the Origin GMT look and feel like a more upscale offering, yet Erebus' relentless focus on value ensures the price remains as affordable as ever. And with the cornerstones of all 316L stainless steel construction, 200m of water resistance, sapphire crystal, and incredible legibility, the Origin GMT remains a tool watch to its core. T he Classic range boasts four model choices, all with applied two-piece logos, framed date windows and comfort enhancements to the custom spec Curved H-Link bracelet. They feature an all-brushed case and bracelet, top grade BGW9 Super-LumiNova, and ceramic or steel 24 click bidirectional bezels, allowing you to quickly and easily track a second time zone. The Premium range goes even further with another four models featuring a new, all-brushed 'J-Style' bracelet designed for ultimate comfort and style. The standout feature of the range though, are the custom made, fully lumed, sandblasted bicolour ceramic bezel inserts. These are something normally found on watches costing thousands of dollars, and not hundreds of dollars. Whether you pick from the Classic or Premium ranges, the Erebus Origin GMT is the ultimate tool watch for travel and adventure.

watches.name: ASCENT 39 Purple Helix
watches.description: Erebus’s first Go Anywhere, Do Anything (GADA) sports watch is more than just a pretty face. Designed to be worn on any occasion, whether at the office, on a night out, a hike, or even a swim, the Ascent always looks like it is worth thousands more than its asking price. The attention to detail the Erebus team have lavished on the Ascent is the reason for its name; it represents an elevation in all elements of its design, its specifications, and its construction. Our vision was simple; analyse the world’s best sports watches, then mix in our own Erebus DNA to create the best value GADA watch possible. Running a Japanese-made Miyota 9015 movement means that the Ascent sports a wrist hugging slimline case profile and enjoys a satisfyingly smooth sweep of its needle-sharp second hand. The case finishing on the Ascent is superb, with the perfect combination of brushing and polishing to give the watch the wrist presence you always want. The multifaceted applied indices and stunning bespoke handset preside over a wide selection of incredible dials, meaning you’re sure to find an Ascent that suits your personal taste and style. Choose between rich and lustrous Enamel, colourful Fumé Sunburst, or mesmerising Erebus branded Helix dials. Or go even more exotic with our mineral dial selection in Aventurine, Malachite and Tigers Eye. Every choice is simply outstanding. Select between either ‘O’ and ‘J’ style bracelets, then add our additional branded leather, rubber, and military-style straps to give your Ascent a different look and feel in seconds. All changes are achieved seamlessly and without tools using our quick release system on all straps and bracelets. The Ascent takes our brand, and your wrist, to the next level.
